home.title: Hi, I'm Luiz 👋
home.intro: This simple page is just the tip of the iceberg. What matters is behind the scenes: it is a static Next.js site, provisioned entirely on AWS with Terraform and published by a CI/CD pipeline on GitHub Actions — all within the free tier.
